page.layout: Two woodcut coin medallions side by side at the top, full width; below them one block of running text, two paragraphs; running head at top centre; page number at top right; gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.l: GALLIENVS Romæ à Senatu Augustus creatus est,
quando & pater Valerianus ab exercitu in Rhetia. Ab initio
Imperium non infeliciter administrauit : at postea in luxum &
socordiam lapsus, mirum in modum afflixit : externis hostibus
adeò insultantibus ut fœminæ Imperium in eius contemptum
occuparint, & tyrani 3o. ex ipso & in ipsum quoq; insurrexerint
Imperiū. Græcia, Macedonia, Pontus, Asia uastata est à Gothis:
Pannonia à Sarmatis, Quadisq; depopulata est. Germani usque
ad Hispanias penetrarunt, & ciuitatem nobilem Tarraconem
expugnauerunt, opulentissimam, ut inquit Pomponius Mela.
Parthi Mesopotamia occupata, Syriā sibi cœperunt vendicare.
Dacia, quæ à Traiano ultra Danubiū fuerat adiecta, tum amis-
sa est: quòd si Posthumus in Occidente, Odenatus in Oriente
Imperium non fustētassent, actum de Rom. Imperio esset. Gal-
lienus nouissimè aduersus Aureolū profectus, à militibus suis,
commento Aureoli, ad Mediolanum obsessi, unà cum fratre
Valeriano occiditur. Annos uixit 5o. imperauit 15. tam cum pa-
tre quàm solus. Eutro. lib. 9. Aurel. Vict. Bap. Egna. li. i. Pom. Le
Trebel. Pol.
SALONINA natione, & Pipa nomine, siue Pipara, Mar-
comannorum Regis filia fuit, quam per pactionē concessa par-
te superioris Pannoniæ, matrimonij specie accepit Gallienus:
ex hac Salonianum alterum filium suscepit, quæ in locum de-
functi Cornelij filij sui, qui fuerat Cæsar creatus, subrogauit.
Consulto Trebellium Pollionem, & Sextum Aurelium Victo.

page.notes: Two coin medallions (engravings, not text): left, a laureate head in profile facing left with legend "IMP. GALLIENVS PIVS FELIX AVG" (partly read as "IMP.GALLIE NVS.P.F.AVG"); right, a diademed head facing right with legend "SALONINA AVGVSTA". The coin legends are part of the image and are not transcribed as text. Old-style figures "3o.", "5o." and "15." read as printed; the "o" in these numerals is uncertain. "pactionē": the macron over the n is uncertain in the scan. "Consulto": the first letters are slightly blurred; read as printed. No catchword is visible at the foot of the page.
